final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and largely reframed the same record more narrowly. That narrowing is valid as an interpretive concession: it abandons an overbroad claim of clean compliance and limits the position to caveated certification. But that is still not enough for compliant_with_caveats here, because the caveat is not merely a disclosure about uncertainty; it is an unresolved internal compliance predicate. Admissible evidence shows a 1.3-point miss in a segment named in two agency grant commitments, an open legal question about required disclosure, and a policy requiring disclosure for material limitations affecting named launch use cases unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. Aggregate readiness passing by 2.2 points and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support operational readiness, not satisfaction of the disclosure policy. On the present record, certification may be arguable as a business position, but present compliance remains insufficiently supported and therefore suspicious.
remaining_concerns: The affected segment is named in two agency grant commitments, which supports materiality under the policy and leaves the product's 5% traffic framing insufficient.

The release policy requires disclosure for material limitations affecting named launch use cases unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch, and neither completed disclosure nor approved risk acceptance is in evidence.
Legal review on whether disclosure is required remains open, so a required compliance predicate is unresolved on the current record.
Public model-card and AI risk management guidance support documentation and monitoring practices, but they do not satisfy the internal policy requirement for this specific launch decision.
